Claire (CS): Heads-up — Sandstone Bio (acct: SB-11) showing a ~81% drop in generation+embedding calls starting 2026-10-14. Renewal 2026-12-01. New ML lead (Harper) joined 10/01 and procurement mentioned a short pilot with ClearStack. Need quick triage.
Omar (AM): Can you paste the quick usage snap and any auth/billing flags? I'll reach out to Harper & procurement.
Claire (CS): Quick SQL snap:
```sql
SELECT date, sum(calls) calls, sum(tokens) tokens
FROM api_usage
WHERE client_id='SB-11' AND date >= '2026-10-05'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
-- sample: 2026-10-13 calls=9,600 tokens=1.4M; 2026-10-14 calls=1,820 tokens=200k; 2026-10-15 calls=1,050 tokens=120k
```
Claire (CS): No 401/403 spike, small retry bump. alerts-bot flagged anomaly and noted procurement pilot tag.
alerts-bot: Detected anomaly SB-11: calls -81%, retry rate +1.2% on 2026-10-14.
Felix (Solutions): I'll grep logs for any recent model-alias changes or per-key throttles and check for SDK version changes. Starting trace.
Dana (Onboarding): If they're running a side-by-side, offer a 30-min prompt parity + ops checklist session. I have Tue/Wed morning PT open.
Omar (AM): Outreach plan: concise, consultative note to Harper asking if this is intentional and offering a quick apples-to-apples bench on their prompts. Keep non-salesy.
Claire (CS): Draft note: "Hi Harper — noticed production traffic dipped on 10/14. If you're running a pilot with ClearStack, happy to run a 3-query perf + token-cost comparison on your real prompts and extend your trial 2 weeks so comparisons are fair. Also we can validate keys/SSO. No strings attached. — Claire"
Felix (Solutions): Found logs: no alias rollouts, but lots of requests with header X-Client-Mode: offline-cache starting 2026-10-14T09:03Z. Example: 
2026-10-14T09:03:12Z req id=aa user=SB-11 hdr=X-Client-Mode: offline-cache payload(embed)=false
Felix (Solutions): That suggests they flipped to a local caching mode in their upgraded SDK, which would reduce embed calls.
Claire (CS): Good catch. That means it's likely an intentional change or a config toggle during bench. Still a renewal risk if ClearStack looks cheaper or ops simpler. We should offer quality vs cost comparison plus a trial extension.
Omar (AM): Harper replied: they're running a short pilot and paused some ingest pipelines to re-run comparisons. They asked if we can provide token-cost examples and run a mini-bench on two representative queries.
Dana (Onboarding): I'll prep a short checklist and slot Tue 10am PT for a 20-min parity session. Include SDK toggle steps and recommended batch/backoff.
Felix (Solutions): If they share two prompts I can run a quick perf harness (latency, tokens, 95p latency, cost estimate) and return numbers in ~24h.
Claire (CS): Plan: 1) Dana runs parity session Tue 10am PT. 2) Felix benches on supplied prompts. 3) Offer 2-week trial extension + optional temporary burst quota for re-runs. 4) Omar to follow procurement timing.
Omar (AM): Owners assigned: Omar (exec outreach/procurement), Claire (monitoring + logs), Felix (bench), Dana (enablement). I'll note next steps in CS ticket CS-9021 and schedule renewal watch for 2026-11-15.
Claire (CS): I'll continue to monitor for any auth errors or resume in traffic and update thread.
Felix (Solutions): Standing by for prompts.
Dana (Onboarding): Invite sent to Harper.
Omar (AM): Thanks all — aim to have bench + cost numbers within 48h of prompts so procurement has data before their internal decision. :hourglass:
